prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: cluster-inventory-api
description: Registers cluster nodes with labels and lists them filtered by label.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /nodes
  description: 'body {name: non-empty string, labels: {string:string}}; 201; 409 if
    name exists; 400 if name missing or malformed JSON'
- method: GET
  path: /nodes
  description: '200 JSON list of nodes; optional query param label=key=value keeps
    only nodes whose labels contain that pair (repeatable: all must match); 400 if
    a label param has no ''='''
- method: GET
  path: /nodes/{name}
  description: 200 one node; 404 if unknown
metrics:
- name: inventory_nodes
  type: gauge
  help: Registered nodes
- name: inventory_queries_total
  type: counter
  help: List queries served
behaviors:
- Filtering with two label params returns only nodes matching both
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /nodes
  expect_status:
  - 201
  body: '{"name": "n1", "labels": {"zone": "a", "gpu": "h100"}}'
- method: POST
  path: /nodes
  expect_status:
  - 409
  body: '{"name": "n1", "labels": {}}'
- method: POST
  path: /nodes
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"labels": {}}'
- method: GET
  path: /nodes?label=zone=a
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /nodes?label=broken
  expect_status:
  - 400
- method: GET
  path: /nodes/n1
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /nodes/zzz
  expect_status:
  - 404
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- inventoryNodes  (gauge) -> exposed as `inventory_nodes`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add
- inventoryQueriesTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `inventory_queries_total`; use Inc/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /nodes  body {name: non-empty string, labels: {string:string}}; 201; 409 if name exists; 400 if name missing or malformed JSON
   - GET /nodes  200 JSON list of nodes; optional query param label=key=value keeps only nodes whose labels contain that pair (repeatable: all must match); 400 if a label param has no '='
   - GET /nodes/{name}  200 one node; 404 if unknown
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
